typeName.description:
Type name.
If not specified, when authorization check, this access control instance will be applied to all types.

innerTypes.description: If true, this access control will be applied to all inner types of #typeName.

action.description:
Action name.
If not specified, when authorization check, this access control instance will be applied to all actions of a type.

condition.description: Expression to be passed to the action for additional visibility filtering

title:
Metadata type used to define access control for specific resource.
Refer to the topic on {@link access-control.c3doc.md Access Control} for usage information.
name: DataPermission
